annotations.title: Estimate China to USA shipping cost

description: Rough price estimate for shipping goods from China to a US address, 100 g to 2,000 kg. Records nothing, contacts no one and needs no email. Inputs: total weight, and optionally the product and carton sizes or total volume. Returns estimated door to door prices in USD for air (and sea from 100 kg chargeable weight), the chargeable weight used (the greater of actual weight and carton volume in cm3 / 6,000), transit estimates, and whether US import duty is included. Figures come from Plain Freight's pricing engine for densely packed goods, priced on the applicable rate; goods that need a review get no figure. The exact ZIP code, pickup city and cartons can move the price, so the result is an estimate, not an offer.

carton_count.description: Number of cartons of that size

product.description: What is being shipped, in a few words (sets the goods rate)

total_cbm.description: Total volume in cubic meters, if known instead of carton sizes

weight_kg.description: Total actual weight of the shipment in kg

name: estimate_price

estimate.description: Always true: a rough figure, not an offer

have_ready.description: Documents or details the person will ask for

verdict.description: instant_offer: priced at once; branded_rate: priced at once on its applicable rate; person_checks_first: no price until a person reviews the goods

estimate_usd.description: Estimated price in USD for the whole shipment

priced_on.description: Date the pricing engine produced these figures
